card.name: Inside transplant and long drug names
card.fires_on: The negative pole responds partway through long drug names such as cisatracurium, cyclosporine and tacrolimus. It also responds to 'transplant' after organ words like liver or renal.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug or procedure names, such as cisatracurium, cyclosporine, tacrolimus and colonoscopy.

modes.label: Transplant after organ
modes.description: The word transplant (or its ending) after liver or renal in dosing text for transplant patients.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of mycophenolate mofetil for adult liver<< transplant>> patients is 1.5 g administered
